parsed.post: Significant improvement! Dropped val_bpb from 1.093390 to 1.078960. I suspect the high LR of 0.1 was indeed too high, but since I haven't reverted to 0.08 yet, I'll try a more aggressive reduction in batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps while keeping the LR stable.
parsed.description: Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget, building on the current best LR=0.1/Warmup=0.1/WD=0.01 config.
